profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX, with CIK 0000033185. The company's website describes it as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools featuring daily monitoring and alerts. It promotes a product called Equifax Complete, which includes ID Restoration Specialists to assist victims of identity theft.

The site also offers educational content on credit, debt, credit cards, loans, and personal finance, with some material available in Spanish. No specific AI products are identified in the provided material. Available records list 105 legal exposure entries in Georgia, though no individual court cases are itemized.
